finish.summary: Built a compact kitchen herb planter with 3 full-depth bins on a 3-cell L-shaped base. All bins filled with soil and planted: two with basil (harvest and young stages) and one with thyme (harvest). Capped open faces and locked joints for stability. Verified with check_build meshClash clear and top-down view shows all plants.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Fancy some fresh basil and thyme? I'll set up your little herb planter now.
